constraints.name: fk_wt_customer
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, customer_id) REFERENCES customers(company_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: fk_wt_installation
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, customer_id, order_id, installation_id) REFERENCES installations(company_id, customer_id, order_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: fk_wt_order
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, customer_id, order_id) REFERENCES orders(company_id, customer_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: warranty_tickets_assigned_to_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (assigned_to) REFERENCES user_profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: warranty_tickets_company_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

triggers.name: trg_tenant_mutation_warranty
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_tenant_mutation_warranty BEFORE UPDATE ON warranty_tickets FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_tenant_mutation()

triggers.name: trg_updated_at_warranty_tickets
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_updated_at_warranty_tickets BEFORE UPDATE ON warranty_tickets FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()

indexes.name: idx_warranty_tickets_assigned
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_warranty_tickets_assigned ON public.warranty_tickets USING btree (company_id, assigned_to, status) WHERE (assigned_to IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: idx_warranty_tickets_status
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_warranty_tickets_status ON public.warranty_tickets USING btree (company_id, status)

indexes.name: warranty_tickets_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX warranty_tickets_pkey ON public.warranty_tickets USING btree (id)
